# Ankhorage Minikube Infrastructure

![license: MIT](././paradox/badges/license.svg) ![npm: v0.4.136](././paradox/badges/npm.svg) ![runtime: bun](././paradox/badges/runtime.svg) ![typescript: strict](././paradox/badges/typescript.svg) ![eslint: checked](././paradox/badges/eslint.svg) ![prettier: checked](././paradox/badges/prettier.svg) ![build: checked](././paradox/badges/build.svg) ![tests: checked](././paradox/badges/tests.svg) ![paradox: warnings](././paradox/badges/docs.svg)

Adapts portable infrastructure workloads to a caller-controlled Minikube cluster.

Provide a Minikube runtime boundary while reusing the shared Kubernetes driver for standard workload behavior.

### Utilities

<details>
<summary>createInfraAdapter</summary>

```ts
createInfraAdapter(options?: MinikubeAdapterOptions | undefined) => InfraRuntimeAdapter<"minikube">
```

Create the canonical Minikube runtime adapter entrypoint.

The caller supplies a Minikube-specific command boundary. Standard workload projection and
reconciliation are delegated to the published Kubernetes driver.
